text: The property had no detected fires during the covered period (2026-10-05 to 2026-11-03), as no thermal anomalies were recorded by NASA FIRMS. However, the evidence is inconclusive for the last two days (2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04) due to gaps in satellite coverage, meaning small or short-lived fires could have occurred without detection. While no fires were confirmed during the monitored days, the lack of data for the final two days prevents a definitive "fire-free" conclusion for the entire period.
